item.title: My Credit Card Stack: Consolidating to 3 Banks and 3 Networks
item.description: Financing a laptop via a zero-cost EMI offer triggered a broader credit card churn — picking up an Axis Neo RuPay card, closing an inactive HDFC Swiggy card, hitting a rejected ICICI Coral application, and landing on a deliberate 3-bank, 3-network card design.

item.title: 💳 Credit Cards: Usage, Risks & Smart Practices
item.description: Credit cards can be powerful tools for rewards, convenience, and short-term liquidity when used with discipline.
